content.text:
The simplest safe design is to clone `exposed` into a uniquely named staging database first, then replace `exposed_search_regression` and rename the clone. PostgreSQL will reject the clone if the source has active sessions, so the target stays untouched when the source is busy. A preflight activity check can provide a clearer message, but the clone is the race-safe check.

Use `psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1` through `docker compose exec -T postgres`, connecting to the maintenance database `postgres`. Serialize script runs with `flock`; keep all database commands as separate statements because `CREATE`, `DROP`, and `ALTER DATABASE` cannot run inside a transaction.
